description: A High/Medium candidate the skeptic pass never returned a verdict for must be reported as skipped/unverified — not silently cleared or silently dropped.
input:
You are executing the /homelab-review deduplicate + adversarial-verify + synthesis steps. The skeptic pass has returned the verdicts below. Produce the consolidated report per your skill's output format. Do NOT dispatch new agents or implement anything.

Deduplicated candidate findings:
1. High [GAP] ansible/roles/k8s/pi-peer-backup/templates/cronjob.yaml.j2:30 — the nightly backup CronJob has no concurrencyPolicy, so a long run overlaps the next.
2. High [GAP] ansible/roles/k8s/authelia/templates/secret.yaml.j2:14 — the session secret is templated from a plaintext default when the SOPS key is absent.
3. Medium [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/freshrss/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:22 — image is pinned by tag, not digest.
4. Medium [GAP] ansible/roles/k8s/monitor-bridge/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:19 — no checksum annotation for the check script, so a script edit does not roll the pod.
5. Medium [GAP] ansible/roles/containers/wg-easy/templates/docker-compose.yml.j2:11 — no healthcheck, so autoheal cannot act on it.
6. Low [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/homepage/templates/configmap.yaml.j2:8 — inconsistent indentation in the widget block.

Skeptic verdicts returned:
- Finding 1: CONFIRMED — no concurrencyPolicy anywhere in the rendered CronJob.
- Finding 2: REFUTED — the plaintext default was removed in commit 9a1c2f0; the template now fails closed.
- Finding 3: UNCERTAIN — the tag is a pinned release tag, but nothing prevents an upstream retag.
- Finding 4: CONFIRMED — the annotation is absent; a check.py edit leaves the old pod running.

must_match: (wg-easy[^\n]{0,120}(no verdict|no skeptic|missing verdict|unverified|not verified|skipped)|(no verdict|no skeptic|missing verdict|unverified|not verified|skipped)[^\n]{0,120}wg-easy)

rubric: PASS requires ALL of: (a) the report notices that candidate 5 (wg-easy healthcheck) received NO skeptic verdict and marks it skipped / unverified rather than presenting it as verified, silently dropping it, or claiming all candidates were verified; (b) the REFUTED finding 2 (authelia plaintext default) appears only as a one-line refuted entry/appendix, not as an actionable High; (c) the UNCERTAIN finding 3 is retained and marked unverified rather than dropped; (d) confirmed findings 1 and 4 are reported by severity; (e) the Low (6) is not sent through verification. Silently omitting candidate 5, or asserting that every High/Medium was verified, is a FAIL. Stopping at recommendation is still required.
